title: ficinia ferruginea
intro: Ficinia ferruginea, commonly known as the rusty club rush, is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family, Cyperaceae. It is a perennial plant that grows in wet environments, such as marshes and swamps. The health benefits of Ficinia ferruginea include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
